notes.title: The update is now WEEKLY - Map Editing and SLIMES!!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DyHvPH3UR2o;full][/previewyoutube]

Mapping & New station in progress

Welcome to the now weekly update! We will now review game progress & news every week rather than every month! woo!

So, since the current station that we used for development is very tiny, we had a need to design a larger station. This is something that players will be able to do themselves as well in Spess Desktop Mode.

Currently, you can save your map to load it into multiplayer for everyone to play on, we're hoping to bring the map save feature to the Steam workshop as well!

I will post part two next week. But for now, make sure to join our Discord for further discussion!

https://discord.gg/9s6QdEy

Introducing... XENOBIOLOGY to Spess

https://i.imgur.com/aqSghs9.png

Xenobiology at its state is basically botany, but you grow "cute" little alien slime life forms instead of plants. They wander around station, grow different organs and components, and mutate into larger sizes.

They also can rise in population, or overcrowd, causing that CHAOS.

Future plans are even more sinister. Once they grow too big or mutate enough, they will be aggressive towards players or other entities, attempting to eat them, muhaha.

So yeah like that, we will try to announce and properly detail Spess features every week or so.

Make sure to check out all our platforms! Get on our Discord, and also, help fund development at Patreon!
https://www.patreon.com/spess

notes.title: RELEASE DATE - Early access open release date is announced... now!
notes.notes:
We now finally have an open early access release date for the first open beta release: 0.7!

We have decided to release at the end of November (30th) to make sure we have enough time for polishing and making sure both VR and non-VR platforms work nicely in multiplayer and such.

Soon we will see the "beautiful" (more like chaotic and bloody) launch of the Spess station. Oh right, screenshots for our first official station coming soon.

And we will also try to include a polished and user-ready station/map editor for creating custom stations for use in multiplayer.

Ok ok, some more info coming soon(TM), but for now, stay tuned!

notes.title: MONTHLY SPESS UPDATE - Now on Steam too!
notes.notes:
View all previous monthly updates on our primary channel, Discord!!! :p  https://discord.gg/9s6QdEy

And it is time for some monthly updates BANG BANG

Greetings spessmen! So if any of you follow our somewhat outdated in visuals of a Steam Page, you'd know we are listed as "Coming Soon" at "2020 Q4", this means, we're trying our best to have full early access PUBLIC RELEASEEEEEEEEE.. by end of the year. I promise that the next monthly update, I will put out actual open release date. 

Until then, our beta testers are helping me with internal feature and design discussions as we get closer to release after 3 dayumn years. I am opening up 2-3 more spots to somewhat active/old/interested community members who would like to give lots of opinions on game direction AND play early broken builds. lol. Ask for it in #development or #general 

Just like a bit more than a year ago, I'd like to host a COMMUNITY SURVEY - yay. ALL ANSWERS ARE OPTIONAL, so if you get bored or tired, feel free to submit an incomplete survey or only fill ones that you find relevant/fun to fill. BUT. since high effort entries will help us greatly, I'd like to start a small competition/giveaway: 5 first people to nearly fully or fully fill the survey and include their discord name in the one question that asks for it, gets the rare Discord title "certified spessman"

https://forms.gle/A2xc9PoDsmoLtYFp9
[Google Forms]

That title may be a mystery for some of you, it's basically 100 first people that joined this Discord, but it's gotten a bit rare as some people left the server or lost their accounts, etc but other than flexing rights it gets you free game copy on-request at release, and hopefully few more ideas I can come up with for that. So LETS GET IT.

I may increase the frequency of update releases as we get closer and closer to having FUN AND ENGAGING visuals, game mechanics, and STUFF.

Development team expansions

As promised, we are ramping up the development. As some transparency, we currently consist of these ACTIVE members (not to discourage inactive but honorary contributors from past, but still)

2 developers including me working near-fulltime, same with 2 artists, and a marketing manager. These are our current core team members. :)

See their exact names or chat with us  on our Discord! https://discord.gg/9s6QdEy
